verdict.rationale: Orrick offers self-service online tools and client portals that handle user data, so asking whether that data is kept out of AI model training is a fair privacy question. The evidence pack has no statement about AI training use, no opt-out control and no data-use policy covering it. The ISO 27001 certification addresses information security, not training-data use, and the GenAI policy builder helps customers govern their own AI use rather than protecting Orrick's users' data.
